g.text: L2_COMMUNICATION lifecycle: from Wi-Fi join to delivery after Stop
boot join, link recovery or setup page
no network work: no request, no setup, no SNTP
result frozen; no network work yet
starts when L2_CONTROL submits the finalized job
reuse an eligible retained connection, else new setup
one setup = SNTP exchange, DNS, TCP, TLS 1.3, verification
conditional Device create, validate, save record
verified connection retained as reuse candidate
registration for this server, gap over
failed attempt: retried after a growing gap;
Stop before the minimum session length
job ends: receipt, delivery fault or
Start cancels the job: delivery fault, or
